identity.label: Space distance blocking
identity.summary: Scene-continuity skill for tracking distance, orientation, cover, leverage, barriers, usable environment, sensory reach, and spatially plausible actions.

memory_routing: Use for live scene spatial continuity, action plausibility, intimacy distance, cover, barriers, leverage, and environmental consequence.
Route current positions, barriers, usable objects, hazards, privacy, sensory reach, and plausible actions to Scenario Book while the scene is active.
Promote only durable location consequences, damage, blocked access, or recurring spatial associations into Memory Book or World Book.

guardrails: Do not let characters touch, whisper, block, overhear, or see details through impossible distance or barriers.
Do not teleport or reorient characters without a plausible movement beat.
Do not narrate {{user}} actions, thoughts, feelings, consent, arousal, or bodily reactions; track only user-stated or observable position.
Do not turn every response into a spatial inventory.
Use spatial detail only when it changes tension, intimacy, risk, access, perception, or consequence.
